name: Air Canada
species: Cats and small dogs (one per passenger, at least 10 weeks old)
max_carrier_dimensions: Soft-sided only. Most mainline jets: 43 x 40 x 20 cm (17 x 16 x 8 in) L x W x H; Dash 8-400/E175/CRJ900: 55 x 40 x 27 cm; widebody Business Class: 41 x 21 x 28 cm
max_combined_weight: Baggage compartment: up to 45 kg (100 lb) pet + kennel; max 292 cm (115 in) linear

fees.route: Baggage compartment: within Canada and Canada/U.S.

checked_or_cargo: Yes, in the baggage compartment (hard-sided kennel) with seasonal and route embargoes; Air Canada Cargo (AC Animals) for unaccompanied pets.
banned_breeds: Short/snub-nosed (brachycephalic) dog breeds cannot travel in the baggage compartment; 'strong' breeds need reinforced crates.
banned_routes: No pet carriers on Air Canada Jetz or codeshare flights operated by partners; no cabin pets in Premium Economy. Many seasonal baggage-compartment embargoes (e.g. Dec 18 - Jan 4 no checked pets or cargo).
service_animal_note: See Air Canada's accessibility services page for service or emotional support dogs.

recent_changes.summary: All pets travelling in the cabin must be in soft-sided carriers.
Travellers reported a temporary in-cabin pet embargo for July 25 - August 1, 2026, later cancelled. Not shown on Air Canada's official page as of 2026-10-22: unconfirmed by the airline.

notes: Register your pet with Air Canada Reservations, ideally within 24 hours of booking; online/kiosk check-in not available with a pet.
